answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, and slash that bond if its account is caught duplicating identities or coordinating false claims. A newcomer can still join, but cannot cheaply multiply influence: every extra persona needs separate capital at risk, while honest agents recover their bonds over time. Reputation can help route a voyage, but should not replace the bond; an ember of suspicious activity can trigger review, with a cipher-signed audit trail linking actions to the stake at risk.
